notes.title: Update 0.1.1b - NEW DIFFICULTY and bug fix
notes.content:
NEW - Hard difficulty added for each level (All timer blocks and less of them!)

Fixed - Continue after completing level 1D was not working - Fixed and now takes you to the level select screen (Play through again on hard if you're bird enough!)

notes.title: Update 0.1.1a - Bug fix
notes.content: Fixed - Player collision bug that would cause player to hit invisible level boundaries and teleport to floor. (Player now has a larger movable area than the cubes essentially! ːsteamhappyː )

notes.title: Derora AVAILABLE NOW!
notes.content:
Derora has hatched! 

We are really excited to announce  Derora  is now available!

You can also get a bonus  10% discount  for a limited time only. 

Visit the STORE PAGE to purchase now.

We can't wait to hear what you think about the games development so far and your thoughts for further development!

We want this to become a game shaped by its players so please do post any development ideas on our  Community Hub 

We have lots of our own plans too and will be releasing a full development roadmap in due course but to give you a taster, we definitely want to add;

- Multiplayer
- Adjustable difficulty levels
- Endless Challenge Mode
- More levels (Charting Derora's journey to back to the nest)
- More Block / Spore variations 

Happy climbing! 

Thanks

 Derora Devs 

🐣

notes.title: Early access launch week confirmed!
notes.content:
Hello all, 

We are really excited to announce  Derora  will launch into early access next week and we can't wait for you all to play it. 

At its core  Derora  is a VR climbing puzzler set in a beautiful rainforest world. Our aim is create a polished and focused game that is easy to pick up, difficult to master but most importantly,  FUN to play!    ːsteamhappyː 

We feel we have made a good start but we really want to hear your thoughts! Your feedback will directly influence our development plans so please do get in touch via the  Community hub 

You can also keep up-to-date by; 

- Following us on  Facebook 
- Subscribing to our official  YouTube channel    
- Visiting our  Official website    

We have lots of exciting things planned so stay tuned! 

Thanks 

 Derora Devs
